name: trip_payment_reminder
description: A reminder to a family who is behind with a trip's payment plan. A voluntary contribution is worded as a request, never a debt (DfE charging policy).
subject: {trip_title} - payment reminder for {pupil_name}
body: You can pay at the school office or online. If you have already paid, thank you - please ignore this reminder.
